kanban-claude 0.2.0.dev11

The /kanban-board pane now lists triage cards. Raw ideas used to be a count in the footer; now they are a lane in the list and a section of rows in the card view, and Enter opens one. The test suite also runs on Linux. This page explains what changed and why.

Release explainer, 2026-10-20. Diff v0.2.0.dev10 (ab3a1ed) to cbc9181 (main). Dev pre-release. The version bump to 0.2.0.dev11 is not part of this diff.

  • 2

    changes: the Triage lane on the pane, and a test fixture fix (PR #3, with its merge commit)

  • 4

    files changed: board.tsx, board.test.ts, conftest.py, current_state.md

  • +64
    −12

    lines added and removed (git diff --shortstat v0.2.0.dev10 cbc9181)

  • 31

    pane test cases in board.test.ts, two of them new; no schema change, no new config key

Background

What was wrong with the pane, and what the fixture got wrong

A raw idea is a card in the triage status: a note the orchestrator has yet to shape into work. It is never dispatched. The pane (plugins/kanban-claude/hooks/board.tsx) counted these cards in its footer legend, as triage 2, and never drew them. On a board that held only ideas and finished cards, the pane read Nothing running or planned. and gave no way to see or open the ideas. The owner hit exactly this: a screenshot showed done 34 · triage 2 under that line.

dev11 makes triage a lane, so the pane can list the ideas and open them. The second change is separate. The test suite fakes the Mac’s tools, but setup’s macOS check reads the real platform, so on a Linux CI runner every test that runs setup failed. That is a fixture fix; the plugin’s behaviour is the same. The board, its database and the config keys do not change. Line numbers are in plugins/kanban-claude/hooks/board.tsx at cbc9181 unless a path says otherwise.

Change diagram

Which components changed, and how

  • + added
  • ~ changed
  • − removed
  • ! fixed
  • = left as it was

Before, the footer held the only mention of triage and neither view drew a card. Now one lane definition feeds both views: the arrow marked raw goes to the card view’s rows under the grid, and the arrow marked listed goes to the list view, where Triage is the last lane. The test fixture has no arrow: it is test setup and does not touch the pane. Every item is explained in the walkthrough.

Render

The owner’s board, before and after

These are 57-cell docks drawn by hand from what the tests expect, not captured from tmux. The board is the one in the owner’s screenshot: 34 done cards and 2 raw ideas. The two idea titles are made up. Triage is drawn faint, in the inactive colour.

Both new views list the ideas under Nothing running or planned.. In the card view the section sits under the lane grid; here there are no lanes, so it follows the line. Each idea row is a button: Enter opens the card’s detail. The footers show the pane unfocused (ctrl+x tab: keys) in the card views and focused (v: cards r: refresh) in the list.

Walkthrough

Area by area

Each area says what changed, why, and how you notice it as the operator.

Triage becomes a lane ~changed+added

What changed
You can now see your raw ideas and open them from the pane. Before, TRIAGE was a plain object, { name, statuses, color }, used only for the footer legend and the status bar. Now it is a Lane (board.tsx:38) with the key triage, the glyph ◇, the colour inactive, and a meta that returns the card’s age through ago(). The comment above it says raw ideas are listed after the lanes, faint, and never dispatched. The pane keeps them apart from lanes (:548): raw holds the triage cards, and listed (:550) is lanes plus a Triage entry at the end, only when raw is not empty. LEGEND shrinks to [DONE] (:39). BAR (:41) still ends with TRIAGE, so the status bar shows the same segments as before.
Why
The pane counted triage cards in its footer and nowhere else. The owner hit it on a live board: a screenshot showed done 34 · triage 2 under Nothing running or planned., with no way to see or open the two ideas. Making triage a lane lets the existing row, head and meta code draw it, instead of a second set of drawing code.
How you notice it
The footer no longer says triage 2; the ideas are listed where you can read them. the list view draws the lanes with their meta, the bar and the legend checks that triage 1 is gone from the legend, that a Triage head is drawn, and that the row reads Raw idea then 1m.

The card view lists triage as rows under the grid +added

What changed
In the card view, ideas come as compact rows, not tiles: a raw idea is a title and an age, so a bordered card would waste three rows on it. The block sits after the lane grid and before Merged (:831). It is a column with a head (◇ Triage and the count) and up to CARDS = 3 rows. Each row is the same row() the list uses, so it is a Button and Enter opens the card’s detail. The lanes come first. spare (:801) is the frame’s bodyRows minus above minus tall(room), which is what is left once the lane grid has its cards. ideas (:802) takes at most min(CARDS, spare) of the ideas. The height budget above now counts the Triage head (:733: a blank row and the head, when there are ideas), so the lane grid cannot push the head off the frame. When no row is spare, Triage keeps its head and count and lists nothing. When the list is cut, +N more is drawn in dim italic, but only if one more row is spare for that line. A board with no lane cards still says Nothing running or planned. once, and the Triage section sits below it.
Why
The lanes are the work in flight, so they get the room first. Ideas fill what is left. Keeping the head and count when there is no room still tells you that ideas exist, and the footer no longer does.
How you notice it
triage cards are listed under the lanes, and Enter opens one checks the head, the row text and that pressing the row runs kanban --json show t_tri. the dock shows as many cards per lane as its height holds, so the footer stays in view now checks two sizes: at 80 rows the idea is listed; at 33 rows the lanes take the space, so Triage is drawn and the idea row is not. The default card test mounts a taller frame (bodyRows: 42), so the triage block does not crowd out its second card per lane.

The list view draws it as the last lane +added~changed

What changed
In the list, Triage is one more entry of listed and goes through the same code as the other lanes. In the dock, the rows come from listed.flatMap (:876) and the heads from listed.map (:886). Inline and wide, the lanes sit side by side, and the column width is now computed from listed.length (:847), so Triage is a fifth column when ideas exist: at 120 columns each is floor((120 − 2·4) / 5) = 22 cells wide, before floor((120 − 2·3) / 4) = 28. The empty-board text still depends on lanes only, not listed, so a board with ideas and no running work reads Nothing running or planned. and lists the ideas below it.
Why
The list should show everything the card view shows. One data source, listed, keeps the two views from drifting apart.
How you notice it
in the list, inline and wide, the lanes sit side by side; narrow, the meta moves under the title now expects a width of 22 for the running card. a board holding only triage cards says nothing runs, and still lists them checks both views: the empty-board text is there, and so is the button for t_tri, before and after v.

The test suite fakes the Mac, platform included !fixed

What changed
This does not change what the plugin does. The autouse env fixture in runtime/tests/conftest.py puts fake launchctl, gh, uv and claude tools on PATH, so that the suite behaves as on the owner’s Mac. One line is added (conftest.py:169): monkeypatch.setattr(install.sys, "platform", "darwin"). install.sys is the sys module, so this sets sys.platform for the test; monkeypatch restores it afterwards.
Why
Setup refuses to run off macOS: check_host() raises when sys.platform != "darwin" (install.py:108). The fixture faked the tools but not the platform, so on a Linux CI runner every test that runs setup stopped at that check. A downstream CI run showed 25 failures and 58 errors across test_setup, test_doctor and test_uninstall. This change came in as PR #3.
How you notice it
On macOS the suite passes as before: 893 passed, 1 xfailed. On Linux the same change was checked in the LDC port’s copy of the suite, in python:3.12-slim with git, procps and sqlite3: 888 passed, 1 xfailed. This repository’s own Linux run was not repeated for this page.

Upgrade notes

Moving from dev10 to dev11

  1. Update the plugin and reopen /kanban-board. The diff changes no table and no config key, so there is no migration. The fixture change touches only the test suite.
  2. Nothing to configure. The view you picked with v is kept as before. If the board holds triage cards, you see them in either view.
  3. If you looked for the triage count in the footer, it is gone. The Triage head carries the count now, and the status bar still shows the segment.

Range covered

The diff runs from the tag v0.2.0.dev10 (ab3a1ed) to cbc9181: cbc9181 (the Triage lane), b314ffb (the fixture fix) and 3a4ee9b (the merge of PR #3). current_state.md ships in the same range. The version bump to 0.2.0.dev11 is not in this diff.

Quiz

Check what you took from this page

Five questions. Pick an answer to see the explanation.

1. A board holds only raw ideas. Before this fix, what did the pane show?

The footer legend held done and triage counts, and nothing drew the triage cards. The empty-board text depends on the lanes only.

2. In the card view the lanes fill the frame and no row is left. What does Triage show?

spare is 0, so ideas is empty. The head is already counted in above (board.tsx:733), so it stays. This is the case the 33-row frame in the dock-height test checks.

3. What does the footer legend show now?

LEGEND is [DONE] (board.tsx:39). BAR (:41) still ends with TRIAGE.

4. In the list, inline at 120 columns, ideas exist. How wide is each of the five columns?

The width is floor((120 − 2·4) / 5) = 22: four gaps of 2 between five columns. The old formula divided by the four lanes only and gave 28 (board.tsx:847).

5. Why did 25 tests fail and 58 error on Linux CI?

check_host() raises unless sys.platform == "darwin" (install.py:108). The fixture now sets install.sys.platform to darwin (conftest.py:169).
